meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 装上后,当用户问起任何 senpi 的 Tip 提示,Claude 会先查实时提示列表、核对用户实际能看到的提示,再读相关源码,给出带文件路径的深度解释,并沿用用户的语言;不凭记忆说明,代码与提示不一致时以代码为准。
howto.when: 当你说“give-me-tips”、询问某条 Tip 提示的含义,或问当前能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip 提示是什么意思?
say.note: Claude 会先查列表再解释。

say.text: Fable 5 被拒后出现的提示是怎么运作的?
say.note: 会讲完整的回退架构流程。

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些 tips?
say.note: 会读取设置并列出可见项。

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi Tip line, Claude queries the live tip list, checks which tips you can actually see, reads the feature code, and gives a deep explanation with file paths, in your language. It never explains from memory; code beats tip text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a Tip line, say give-me-tips, ask what a tip means, or ask which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What does that Tip line in the UI mean?
say_en.note: Claude checks the list first, then explains.

say_en.text: How does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal actually work?
Which tips can I currently see?
say_en.note: Reads your settings and lists visible tips.
